intro.text: Llarimar's daughter and Lightsong's favourite niece, whom he saved when she was swept into the sea.

items.text: Tatara often went sailing with her father, whose pastime it was, and her uncle. On one trip a terrible storm hit, and when she left the cabin to help her father, a huge wave washed her overboard. Her uncle, though hardly able to swim, leapt in after her and got a rope around her; she was saved, but he drowned, and Returned as Lightsong.

appearance.text: A youthful face, brown hair and dark tan skin; Lightsong rhapsodises over the shade of her red lips.
